classification.difficultyReason: Separate the tip from total earnings before calculating the hourly wage.

content.prompt: Calculate the hourly pay if a person worked a 4-hour shift and earned \$45 including a \$5 tip.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 15, payment strip beneath the prompt
spec.description: Four equal hourly wage sections followed by a separate tip section. Hour boundaries are labelled 0 to 4, with Time worked above and a total brace labelled $45 below the complete strip.
spec.mathematics: Four hours of wages plus a $5 tip total $45. The terminal tip section is not an additional hour.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied labels remain visible; the calculated hourly wage appears only in the answer.
